description: This file contains the implementation of the ProxyGenerator class within the Orleans.CodeGenerator namespace. It is responsible for generating proxy classes that implement RPC invokers, including methods for creating proxy methods, constructors, and handling asynchronous invocation logic. The class interacts with other components like CopierGenerator, InvokableGenerator, and SerializerGenerator to facilitate code generation for Orleans grain proxies.

classes.name: ProxyGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating proxy classes that implement RPC invokers, including methods for creating proxy methods, constructors, and handling asynchronous invocation logic within the Orleans code generation framework.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates a proxy class declaration and its description based on the provided interface description, including fields, methods, and constructors.

methods.name: GetSimpleClassName
methods.description: Returns a sanitized simple class name for the proxy based on the interface description's name.

methods.name: GetFieldDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves descriptions for fields needed in the proxy class, including copiers for method parameters.

methods.name: GetFieldDeclarations
methods.description: Creates field declaration syntax nodes from field descriptions.

methods.name: CreateProxyMethods
methods.description: Creates proxy method declarations for each method in the interface description, including async handling.

methods.name: CreateAsyncProxyMethodBody
methods.description: Constructs the body of an asynchronous proxy method, handling request creation, parameter copying, invocation, and response handling.

methods.name: GenerateConstructors
methods.description: Generates constructors for the proxy class, including calls to base class constructors and initialization of fields.

methods.name: GetParameterSyntax
methods.description: Creates parameter syntax nodes for method parameters, including ref/out/in modifiers.
